record.title: Non-uniform sampling for geometric-graph Dirichlet partitions
record.statement: Generalize Theorem 1 to non-uniformly sampled points. This would require showing that a generalized Dirichlet energy admits a continuous minimizer on $H^1_0(U;\Sigma_k)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/29](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15437), page 45. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Nontrivial higher homotopy groups of the observer moduli space of positive Ricci metrics on spheres
record.statement: For every $k\in\mathbb{N}$, there is an integer $N(k)$ such that, for every odd $n>N(k)$, the group $\pi_i\!\left(\mathcal{M}_{x_0}^{\mathrm{Ric}>0}(S^n),[g_0]\right)$ is non-trivial whenever $i\le 4k$ and $i\equiv 0\pmod 4$, where $g_0$ is the standard round metric on $S^n$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/3](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15208), page 8. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Dupont–Monod comparison-map conjecture
record.statement:
Let $G$ be a connected semisimple Lie group with finite center. Then the natural comparison map
\[
H^n_{\mathrm{cb}}(G;\mathbb{R})\longrightarrow H^n_{\mathrm{c}}(G;\mathbb{R})
\]
is an isomorphism for every degree $n\ge 0$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/30](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15438), page 42. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Non-KAM-stable elliptic equilibria for smooth Hamiltonians
record.statement: For every dimension parameter \(d\ge 3\), examples of smooth Hamiltonians are presented having elliptic equilibria with arbitrary frequency that are not KAM-stable.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/32](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15575), page 6. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Birkhoff’s disk-like global-surface-of-section conjecture for the retrograde orbit
record.statement: In the planar circular restricted three-body problem, below the first critical value of the Jacobi constant, does the retrograde orbit bound a disk-like global surface of section, for arbitrary mass ratios?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/32](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15575), page 6. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Dynamically convex contact forms on $S^3$ violating the Viterbo bound
record.statement: For every $\\varepsilon>0$ there exists a dynamically convex contact form $\\alpha$ on $S^3$ such that $\\rho(S^3,\\alpha)>2-\\varepsilon$; here dynamically convex means that every closed Reeb orbit has Conley–Zehnder index at least $3$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/32](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15575), page 15. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uniform constants in the nonlinear Hausdorff–Young inequality
record.statement:
For the nonlinear Fourier transform described in the report, let $p'=\frac{p}{p-1}$ and let $C_p$ be the optimal constant in
$$
\left\|\bigl(\log|a|^2\bigr)^{1/2}\right\|_{L^{p'}(\mathbb R)}\le C_p\|f\|_{L^p(\mathbb R)},\qquad 1\le p\le 2.
$$
Are the optimal constants $C_p$ bounded uniformly for $1\le p\le 2$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15577), page 26. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Zygmund’s directional maximal-operator problem for Lipschitz vector fields
record.statement:
Let $v:\mathbb{R}^2\to S^1$ be a $1/100$-Lipschitz unit vector field. Is the associated directional maximal operator
\[
M_v f(x):=\sup_{0<r<1}\frac{1}{r}\int_{-r}^{r} f\bigl(x+v(x)t\bigr)\,dt
\]
bounded on any $L^p(\mathbb{R}^2)$, $1<p<\infty$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15577), page 58. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Boundedness of the directional Hilbert transform for Lipschitz vector fields
record.statement:
Let $u:\a0\mathbb{R}^{2}\to[-1,1]$ be $1/100$-Lipschitz, and define
\[
H_{u}f(x,y):=\operatorname{p.v.}\int_{-1}^{1}f\bigl(x+r,y+u(x,y)r\bigr)\,\frac{\mathrm{d}r}{r}.
\]
Is $H_{u}$ bounded on any $L^{p}(\mathbb{R}^{2})$ space with $1<p<\infty$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/34](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15577), page 59. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Nonexistence of edge-cone Yamabe metrics for intermediate cone angles
record.statement: For every integer $n\geq 3$ and every $\beta$ with $1<\beta<2$, there is no edge-cone Yamabe metric in the conformal class $(\mathbb{S}^{n},[h_{\beta}])$, where $h_{\beta}=dr^{2}+\beta^{2}\sin^{2}r\,d\theta^{2}+\cos^{2}r\,g_{\mathbb{S}^{n-2}}$ is the standard edge-cone metric of cone angle $2\pi\beta$ along $\mathbb{S}^{n-2}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/36](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15579), page 45. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Polynomial-size selector gadgets for the PSD-rank lifting theorem
record.statement: Can one prove that the assertion of Theorem 4—namely, for every function $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}_+$ with $\mathbb{E}f=1$, $\operatorname{rank}_{\mathrm{psd}}(M^{f}_{\mathrm{SEL}_m})\ge n^{\Omega(\deg_{\mathrm{sos}}(f)+o(1))}$—continues to hold when the condition $m\le cn$ for some constant $c>1$ is weakened to $m\le n^{O(1)}$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/37](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15580), page 29. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Relation between the invariant \(\rho_1\) and Rozansky’s 2-loop invariant
record.statement:
For every knot \(K\), conjecture that
\[
\rho_1(K;t^2)=\frac{t^2}{(1-t^2)^2}\,P^{(1)}(K;t),
\]
where \(\rho_1\) is the normalized invariant defined in the report and \(P^{(1)}\) is the Laurent-polynomial invariant arising from the perturbative expansion of the colored Jones polynomial.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/38](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15581), page 13. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Burgess bound for Dirichlet $L$-functions
record.statement:
For a primitive Dirichlet character $\c7$ modulo $M$, with $M$ assumed prime for simplicity, the note establishes

$$L\left(\tfrac12,\u0003c7\right)\ll M^{3/16+\varepsilon}.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/40](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15583), page 35. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Lower bound for the interacting quantum backflow operator
record.statement:
Suppose that \(V\) satisfies \(\int dx\,(1+|x|)|V(x)|<\infty\). Then, for every \(f\in\mathcal S(\mathbb R)\) with \(f\ge 0\), there exists a constant \(c_{V,f}>0\) such that
\[
E_+\Omega_{\mathrm{in}}J_f\Omega_{\mathrm{in}}^*E_+\ge -c_{V,f}\,\mathbf 1.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/41](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15584), page 53. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Strong approximate innerness of diagonal quasi-free finite abelian actions
record.statement: Is every finite, abelian group action \(\alpha:G\curvearrowright \mathcal O_A\) by diagonal quasi-free automorphisms on a simple, purely infinite Cuntz–Krieger algebra strongly approximately inner in the sense of Izumi? That is, is each \(\alpha_g\) a point-norm limit of inner automorphisms implemented by unitaries in the fixed-point algebra \(\mathcal O_A^\alpha\)?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/42](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15585), page 21. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Unimodality of Ehrhart $h^*$-polynomials for IDP lattice polytopes
record.statement: Every lattice polytope $P$ with the integer decomposition property—that is, for every integer $k\ge 1$, every lattice point of $kP$ is a sum of $k$ lattice points of $P$—has a unimodal Ehrhart $h^*$-polynomial.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15587), page 13. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Real-rootedness of h*-polynomials of dilated lattice polytopes
record.statement: For a $d$-dimensional lattice polytope $P$, the $h^*$-polynomial of $rP$ has only real zeros for all integers $r \ge d$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15587), page 15. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Stanley-type inequalities for spanning lattice polytopes
record.statement:
Let $P$ be a spanning lattice polytope of degree $s$, so that the rightmost nonzero entry of its $h^*$-vector $h^*(P)=(h^*_0,h^*_1,\ldots,h^*_s)$ has index $s$. Then, for every $i,j\in\mathbb{N}$ with $i+j<s$, one has
\[
h^*_1+h^*_2+\cdots+h^*_i\le h^*_{j+1}+h^*_{j+2}+\cdots+h^*_{j+i}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15587), page 29. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Hensley’s conjecture for 3-dimensional simplices
record.statement: Let $\Delta \subseteq \mathbb{R}^3$ be a lattice tetrahedron with exactly $k>0$ interior lattice points. Then the normalized volume of $\Delta$ is at most $36(k+1)$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/44](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15587), page 33. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Infinite free sets for irregular minimal almost automorphic subshifts
record.statement: Let $(\Sigma,\mathbb{Z})$ be a minimal almost automorphic subshift. If it is irregular, then there exists an infinite set $S\subseteq\mathbb{Z}$ such that, for every $a\in\{0,1\}^{S}$, there is some $\xi\in\Sigma$ with $\xi_s=a_s$ for all $s\in S$. In particular, $(\Sigma,\mathbb{Z})$ has positive topological sequence entropy.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/46](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15951), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Decomposition of homeomorphisms between FLC tiling spaces
record.statement:
Let 
\(\Omega\) and \(\Omega'\) be aperiodic, minimal, finite-local-complexity tiling spaces, with \(\Omega\) uniquely ergodic. For every homeomorphism \(h:\Omega\to\Omega'\), there exists a homeomorphism \(\alpha:\Omega\to\Omega'\) that is local and a continuous function \(s:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}^d\) such that
\[
h=\alpha\circ\tau_s,\qquad \tau_s(T)=T_{-s(T)}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/46](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15951), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Projection dimensions of products of ×2- and ×3-invariant measures
record.statement:
Let $\bc$ (respectively, $\bd$) be a $\d7 2$ (respectively, $\d7 3$) invariant measure on $[0,1]$. Let $\b8=\bc\otimes\bd$. Then, for every orthogonal projection $\c0$ that is not one of the coordinate projections, 
$$
dim(\c0_\\b8)=\inf\{1,dim(\b8)\}.
$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/47](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15952), page 15. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Furstenberg’s intersection conjecture for ×p- and ×q-invariant sets
record.statement: If $A,B\subset[0,1]$ are closed and invariant under the maps $x\mapsto px\pmod 1$ and $x\mapsto qx\pmod 1$, respectively, and if $\frac{\log p}{\log q}\notin\mathbb{Q}$, then for all real numbers $u$ and $v$, $$\dim_H\bigl((uA+v)\cap B\bigr)\le \max\{0,\dim_H(A)+\dim_H(B)-1\}.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/47](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15952), page 17. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Hochman’s exponential separation question for roots of −1,0,1-polynomials
record.statement: For each $n\ge 1$, let $P_n$ be the set of polynomials of degree less than $n$ with coefficients in $\{-1,0,1\}$, and let $E_n=\{\alpha\in\mathbb C:\exists P\in P_n\text{ such that }P(\alpha)=0\}$. Is the following assertion true? There exists $A\ge 0$ such that, for every $n\ge 1$ and every distinct $\alpha,\beta\in E_n$, $|\alpha-\beta|\ge e^{-An}$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/47](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15952), page 37. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Erdős–Szemerédi sum-product conjecture over the reals
record.statement:
For every $\[1m\varepsilon>0\[0m$, there is a constant $c(\varepsilon)>0$ such that every finite set $A\subset\mathbb{R}$ satisfies
\[
\max\{|A+A|,|AA|\}\ge c(\varepsilon)|A|^{2-\varepsilon}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/47](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15952), page 45. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Non-Parreau–Widom sets with a Totik–Widom bound
record.statement: Does there exist a compact set $E\subset\mathbb{R}$ of positive logarithmic capacity that is not a Parreau–Widom (PW) set, but for which there is a constant $D<\infty$ such that $t_n\le D\,\operatorname{Cap}(E)^n$ for all $n\ge 1$?

record.title: Dry Ten Martini Problem for the almost Mathieu operator

record.title: Boyer–Gordon–Watson equivalence for graph manifolds
record.statement: For every closed, connected, orientable graph manifold $M$, $M$ is not an L-space if and only if $\\pi_1(M)$ is left-orderable.

record.title: Even-order cases of the logarithmically averaged Chowla conjecture
record.statement:
For every even integer $k\ge 4$ and every collection of distinct nonnegative integers $h_1,\ldots,h_k$, is it true that
\[
\frac{1}{\log x}\sum_{n\le x}\frac{\mu(n+h_1)\cdots\mu(n+h_k)}{n}\longrightarrow 0\qquad (x\to\infty)?
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/51](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15956), page 30. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Erdős–Ingham Tauberian question for a non-decreasing function
record.statement:
Let $f:\mathbb{R}_{>0}\to\mathbb{R}_{>0}$ be non-decreasing. If
\[
f(x)+f\!\left(\frac{x}{2}\right)+f\!\left(\frac{x}{3}\right)+f\!\left(\frac{x}{5}\right)=\left(\frac{61}{30}+o(1)\right)x
\quad\text{as }x\to\infty,
\]
does it necessarily follow that
\[
f(x)=(1+o(1))x\quad\text{as }x\to\infty?
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/51](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15956), page 31. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Periodic striped ground states for the two-dimensional dipolar Ising model

record.title: Almost-total enumeration degrees and graph-cototality
record.statement: Is every almost-total enumeration degree graph-cototal? Here an enumeration degree $A$ is almost total if, for every total enumeration degree $e$ with $e\not\le_e A$, the join $e\oplus A$ is total; it is graph-cototal if it has a representative of the form $\operatorname{Graph}(f)^c$ for a total function $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15986), page 11. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Almost-everywhere uniform computable categoricity for finite-branching trees
record.statement: Franklin and Miller conjecture that, for finite-branching infinite trees in the original signature, without branching predicates, measure-0-many of these trees are uniformly computably categorical.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15986), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finite final segments of the d.c.e. degrees

record.title: Martin-Löf random real with low discrepancy under powers of 2
record.statement:
For a sequence $(x_n)_{n\ge 1}$ of real numbers, define
\[
D_N\bigl((x_n)_{n\ge 1}\bigr)=\sup_{0\le a<b<1}\left|\frac{1}{N}\#\{n:1\le n\le N\text{ and }\{x_n\}\in[a,b)\}-(b-a)\right|,
\]
where $\{x\}=x-\lfloor x\rfloor$. Is there a Martin-Löf random real $x$ such that, for every sufficiently large $N$,
\[
D_N\bigl((2^n x)_{n\ge 1}\bigr)=O\!\left(\frac{\log N}{N}\right)?
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15986), page 30. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Segal’s conjecture for finite groups
record.statement:
For every finite group $G$, the tautological map $s\colon A(G)\to K(\mathrm{Fin})^0(BG)$ induces an isomorphism
$$\widehat{A(G)}_{I}\xrightarrow{\cong} S^0(BG),$$
where $A(G)$ is the Burnside ring and $I$ is the augmentation ideal.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/15](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16156), page 31. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Lower-bound part of the Malle conjecture (LB-Malle)
record.statement:
For the counting function $N(G,y)$ of Galois extensions $E/k$ with group $G$ and discriminant norm $\left|N_{k/\mathbb{Q}}(d_{E})\right|\le y$, does there exist a positive constant $\alpha(G)$ and a positive constant $y_0$, both depending on $G$, such that
\[
N(G,y)\ge y^{\alpha(G)}\quad\text{for every }y\ge y_0?
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/17](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16158), page 12. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: The Beckmann–Black problem over \(\mathbb Q\)

record.title: Upgrading Problem
record.statement: Let $\alpha:G\curvearrowright X$. Let $(M_j)_{j\in J}$ be a family of subgroups of $G$ such that $\left\langle\bigcup_{j\in J}M_j\right\rangle=G$. Assume that, for every $j\in J$, $X^{\alpha(M_j)}\neq\varnothing$. Under which condition can we conclude that $X^{\alpha(G)}\neq\varnothing$?

record.title: Fixed-point property for elementary groups on noncommutative $L^q$-spaces
record.statement: Assume that $R$ is a finitely generated unital associative ring. For every $n\ge 4$, let $G_R=E(n,R)$ be the elementary group. Then $G_R$ has property $(F^{\mathcal E})$, where $\mathcal E$ is the class of all noncommutative $L^q$-spaces, for $q\in(1,\infty)$; equivalently, every affine isometric action of $E(n,R)$ on every space in $\mathcal E$ has a global fixed point.

record.title: Equality of the Andreadakis–Johnson and representation-theoretic filtrations
record.statement: For every free-group rank $n\ge 3$ and every integer $k\ge 1$, conjecture that $A_n(k)=D_n(k)$, where $A_n(k)$ is the $k$-th term of the Andreadakis–Johnson filtration of $\operatorname{Aut}F_n$ and $D_n(k)$ is the kernel of the action of $\operatorname{Aut}F_n$ on $J/J^{k+1}$ for the universal $\mathrm{SL}(2,\mathbb C)$-representation ring construction described in the report.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/2](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15987), page 47. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Finite generation for homology of configuration spaces of arbitrary graphs
record.statement: Is the functor $G\mapsto H_q(\operatorname{Conf}_k(G))$ from the category of graphs and injective maps to abelian groups finitely generated for all $k,q\ge 0$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/2](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15987), page 62. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Homological stability for orthogonal-group inclusions
record.statement:
Let $k$ be a maximal ordered field (for example, $k=\mathbb{R}$). For all $n$ and $i$, consider the monomorphism of discrete orthogonal groups
$$O_n(k)\times O_i(k)\hookrightarrow O_{n,i}(k).$$
Does this map induce an isomorphism
$$H_d\bigl(O_n(k)\times O_i(k),\mathbb{Z}\bigr)\longrightarrow H_d\bigl(O_{n,i}(k),\mathbb{Z}\bigr)$$
for $n\gg d,i$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2018/2](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15987), page 71. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
